question: The Earth completes one rotation on its axis approximately in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**24 hours**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rotation of the Earth:** The Earth completes one full rotation around its axis in approximately **24 hours**. This rotation is responsible for the alternation of day and night.
 
• The Earth's axis is tilted at an angle of approximately **23.5 degrees**, which plays a significant role in the variation of day length across seasons.
 
• The rotation occurs from **west to east**, which is why the Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• **Time Division:** The 24-hour rotation period is divided into **daytime** and **nighttime**. Daytime occurs when a part of the Earth faces the Sun, while nighttime occurs when it faces away from the Sun.
 
• This rotation impacts various Earth processes, including the **movement of air masses**, the creation of ocean currents, and the Coriolis effect. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• **Incorrect Options:**
 
 
• **365 days:** This value refers to the Earth's **revolution around the Sun**, not its rotation on its axis.
 
• **30 days:** This corresponds roughly to a month and is unrelated to Earth's rotation.
 
• **12 hours:** This is the approximate time for half of a rotation (day or night), not the full rotation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rotation of Earth:**

 
 
• The Earth rotates around its axis, an imaginary line passing through the North and South Poles.
 
• The speed of rotation at the equator is approximately **1670 km/hour** or **465 meters/second**.
 
• The rotation is responsible for the apparent motion of celestial bodies like the Sun, Moon, and stars.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Earth's Rotation:**
 
 
• The rotation causes the **Coriolis effect**, influencing wind patterns and ocean currents.
 
• It leads to the formation of **time zones** across the globe based on the rotation and division of Earth into 24 zones.
 
• The rotation also affects the Earth's shape, making it an **oblate spheroid**, slightly flattened at the poles and bulging at the equator.
 
 
 
• **Revolution vs. Rotation:**
 
 
• **Revolution:** The Earth's movement around the Sun, taking approximately **365.25 days** and resulting in the change of seasons.
 
• **Rotation:** The spinning of Earth on its axis, taking approximately **24 hours** and causing day and night.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Effects of Earth's Rotation:**

 
 
• The alternation of day and night is one of the most visible effects of Earth's rotation.
 
• The rotation influences the direction of wind systems and ocean currents due to the **Coriolis effect**.
 
• It also impacts the biological rhythms of living organisms, including humans, known as **circadian rhythms**.
 
 
 
• **Interesting Facts:**
 
 
• The Earth's rotation is gradually slowing down due to tidal forces, increasing the length of a day by approximately **1.7 milliseconds** every century.
 
• The phenomenon of **precession** causes a slow change in the orientation of Earth's axis over a period of **26,000 years**.
